d: 🚗 Auction Ground Operations Assistant / Vehicle Movement Coordinator
Job Level: Operations / Vehicle Logistics Coordination

We are seeking a reliable, organized, and hands-on professional to support daily auction ground operations and coordinate vehicle movements. The ideal candidate will help ensure vehicles are properly received, inspected, positioned, and transferred within the auction facility while maintaining accurate records and supporting smooth operational workflows.
Coordinate the movement, parking, and positioning of vehicles within the auction premises.
Assist with vehicle receiving, registration, tagging, and inventory updates.
Monitor vehicle arrivals, departures, transfers, and storage locations.
Support auction preparation by ensuring vehicles are properly arranged and ready for inspection or display.
Conduct basic vehicle condition checks and report visible damage or discrepancies.
Coordinate with drivers, auction staff, transport providers, and operations teams.
Maintain accurate vehicle movement logs, inventory records, and related documentation.
Ensure vehicles are handled safely and moved according to operational procedures.
Assist with loading, unloading, and vehicle dispatch arrangements when required.
Identify operational delays and report issues to the relevant supervisor.
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and safety standards across the auction ground.
Understanding of vehicle operations, logistics, or warehouse coordination is an advantage.
Valid driving licence and confidence in handling different types of vehicles.
Ability to follow vehicle handling and safety procedures.
Basic computer skills for updating records and tracking vehicle movements.
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies.
Physically capable of supporting ground operations and outdoor activities.
Reliable, punctual, and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
Practical exposure to automotive auction operations.
Opportunities to develop vehicle logistics and operations skills.
Potential for career growth within automotive and logistics operations.
